description: This file contains classes related to the internal implementation of a grain directory partition in the Orleans distributed runtime. It defines the GrainInfo class for managing individual grain activation data and the LocalGrainDirectoryPartition class for managing a partition of grains, including adding, removing, and merging activation data, as well as handling partition splits and merges.

classes.name: GrainInfo
classes.description: Manages information about a grain's activation(s), including creation, removal, and merging of activation data.

classes.name: LocalGrainDirectoryPartition
classes.description: Manages a partition of grain directory entries, supporting operations like add, remove, lookup, merge, and split for distributed grain management.

methods.name: OkToRemove
methods.description: Determines if a grain activation can be removed based on the cause and delay.

methods.name: TryAddSingleActivation
methods.description: Attempts to add a new activation for the grain, replacing or maintaining existing one based on conditions.

methods.name: RemoveActivation
methods.description: Removes a specific activation of a grain from the partition.

methods.name: RemoveGrain
methods.description: Removes all activations of a grain from the partition.

methods.name: LookUpActivation
methods.description: Retrieves the address and version tag of a grain's activation.

methods.name: GetGrainETag
methods.description: Gets the version tag (ETag) for a grain.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges another partition into this one, returning activations to deactivate.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Splits entries based on a predicate, used during handoff for partition management.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Replaces the internal partition data with a new dictionary.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Applies a delta update to the partition data.
